reasoning: On the season so far the Hawks are the stronger team; with home court the Hawks start about 8 points better, in a game of about 234 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Bucks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Hawks win 71 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 207 and 255 total points.
